title: NeuroCAD Physics v3 bounded analytical workflow expansion

predecessor.relationship: versioned engineering successor; frozen v2 protocol, evidence, release artifacts, and claims remain unchanged

objective: Add bounded mechanics, thermal, vibration, fluid, coupled, uncertainty, and CAD-annotation workflows without presenting analytical scalars as FEA, CFD, physical validation, or independent reproduction.
implemented: temperature-aware material cards with in-range interpolation only
reusable named load cases and algebraic load combinations
series and single-bank parallel pipe networks
interval-corner, seeded Monte Carlo, and local-sensitivity propagation
canonical composite generation for hollow shafts, I-beams, L-brackets, and perforated plates
exact idealized composite geometry, centroid, section, mass-inertia, and bounded structural screening
excluded: spatial stress, displacement, temperature, pressure, or velocity fields
claim_boundary: The implementation and automated tests support software behavior and hand-checkable formula conformance only. They do not establish real-world accuracy, safety, publication novelty, FEA/CFD equivalence, or scientific independence.
